content:
watchOS 27 is Apple's latest major software update for Apple Watch. In addition to several new features, it also adds three new apps to your watch.

#1: Siri

Siri has undergone a major AI revamp in watchOS 27, part of which is a brand new Siri app.

The Siri app is available on iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple Vision Pro, and Apple Watch.

watchOS 27 still lets you summon Siri with the Digital Crown, but this app is another entry point for starting conversations. More importantly, the app is also where you can browse through your past conversation history.

The new AI-powered Siri is more conversational than ever before, and keeps track of your past queries across all your devices. So the Siri app in watchOS 27 doesn't just show your conversations on Apple Watch, but also the history from your iPhone, Mac and other devices.

#2: Find My

Alongside the new features coming to the Find My app in iOS 27, Apple has also redesigned the Find My experience on watchOS this year.

In watchOS 26, Find My was split into three separate apps: Find Devices, Find Items and Find People.

But in watchOS 27, Apple has combined all its finding functionality into one new, unified "Find My" app.

Find My on Apple Watch offers everything the three previous apps did, but in a much more streamlined experience that makes it easy to find anything or anyone in a map-centric interface.

You can switch between different search targets through the menu in the top-left corner, otherwise the interface is largely the same.

#3: Readiness

If you have an Apple Watch Series 12 or Apple Watch Ultra 4, watchOS 27 also adds a third app: Readiness.

Here's how the App Store describes what the Readiness app does:

The Readiness app analyzes your recent activity, vitals and sleep data to help you understand your condition for the day. Features: Get a score and clear readiness classification, including "Recover," "Pace Yourself," "Ready," or "Go For It." View explanations of contributing factors and tap through to the relevant app. New complications and Smart Stack widgets for at-a-glance info. See more detail in the Fitness app on iPhone.

In short, Readiness gives you a quick overview of your overall physical condition so you know how rested and prepared you are for the day.

What are your thoughts on the new Apple Watch apps in watchOS 27? Feel free to share with us in the comments.
